name: TensorFeed x402 Base Reader (MCP)
description: Read-only Model Context Protocol server for verifying x402 payment settlements on Base mainnet. Eleven tools: verify on-chain that a USDC settlement matches a claimed x402 receipt (recipient + amount), parse publisher /.well-known/x402 manifests, list recent USDC payments to a merchant address, check AFTA federation status, plus generic Base reads (balance, USDC balance, get_tx_receipt, eth_call, block_number, recent_transfers). No private keys, no signing, no broadcasts. Drops into any MCP-compatible AI client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Continue). MIT, published with cryptographic provenance via GitHub Actions OIDC. Listed in the canonical Model Context Protocol registry as ai.tensorfeed/x402-base-mcp. Install: npx -y @tensorfeed/x402-base-mcp.
